title: Language steering in latent space to mitigate unintended code-switching
abstract: arXiv:2510.13849v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit hallucinations such as unintended code-switching, reducing reliability in downstream tasks. We propose latent-space language steering, a lightweight inference-time method that identifies language directions via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on parallel translations and steers token embeddings along these axes to control language identity. Our approach mitigates code-switching (reduced next-token distributional divergence by up to 55\%, reduced Code-Switching Index by 63--99\%) while preserving broad semantic direction with negligible computational overhead and requires only minimal parallel data for calibration. Additionally, we evaluate language classification using a single principal component (95-99\% accuracy) and further analyze the layer-wise evolution of language representations.

translated_title: 在潜空间中进行语言引导以缓解无意的语码切换
translated_abstract: 多语言大语言模型（LLM）经常表现出诸如无意语码切换之类的幻觉现象，降低了下游任务的可靠性。我们提出了潜空间语言引导方法，这是一种轻量级的推理时方法，通过对平行翻译进行主成分分析（PCA）来识别语言方向，并沿这些方向轴引导词元嵌入，从而控制语言身份。我们的方法缓解了语码切换问题（下一词元分布散度降低高达55%，语码切换指数降低63%至99%），同时保持了广泛的语义方向，计算开销几乎可以忽略不计，并且只需要极少的平行数据进行校准。此外，我们还使用单个主成分进行了语言分类评估（准确率达95-99%），并进一步分析了语言表示在各层中的演化过程。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过对平行翻译做主成分分析来识别语言方向、并在潜空间中引导词元嵌入的轻量级推理时方法，可将多语言大模型的无意语码切换指数降低63%至99%，且几乎不增加计算开销、仅需极少平行数据校准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight inference-time method that identifies language directions via PCA on parallel translations and steers token embeddings in latent space, reducing unintended code-switching in multilingual LLMs by 63-99% with negligible computational overhead.
